description.value: Daily Delicious is an artisan bakery in Richmond founded in April 2019, blending French pastry technique with Asian-inspired flavours — think salted egg yolk croissants, taro cream butter croissants, and baguettes with Masago butter sauce. Their seafood croissant was voted No. 1 in the 2020 Vancouver Foodster Croissant Challenge. The bakery uses only natural ingredients with no chemicals or additives, applying a slow dough-resting process for depth of flavour.
